note: P is largely one design: all four are bottom-right dark rounded cards with a green accent, and P2 and P3 are near duplicates (icon or dot, green progress bar under the header, chevron, vertical step list), with P1's step dots and P4's open-by-default card the only departures. Q is also all bottom-right dark, but it changes the collapsed form (pill with count, pill with days, pill with weekday), the palette (amber, green, blue, mixed) and the open content (carrier tabs, vertical timeline, segmented progress), though the vertical timeline repeats in three of them.
